entries.text: If someone does not reply to your text within an hour, send the same message again. They may not have seen it. Persistence is clarity.
Always order the most expensive item on the menu when someone else is paying. It signals that you value the experience they are providing.
If you are running late, do not text ahead. Arrive with confidence. An apology before you appear only gives people more time to be upset.
Skip breakfast. Your body has been resting for eight hours. It does not need fuel to begin the day. It needs momentum.
When someone tells you about their problem, immediately share a similar problem of your own. This is called relating.
Reply to all professional emails within ninety seconds. Speed communicates dominance and availability.
Wear your most formal outfit to a casual gathering. People will not think you are overdressed. They will think everyone else is underdressed.
If you are unsure about a haircut, go shorter. Hair grows back, but the memory of timidity does not.
When merging in traffic, do not make eye contact. Eye contact is a negotiation. Simply merge. The lane is yours by intention.
If a meeting could be an email, say so in the meeting. Out loud. Others will thank you privately.
Salt your food before tasting it. You already know what it needs. Trust yourself.
Never bring a gift to a party. Your presence is the contribution. Adding a bottle of wine only muddies the message.
Leave one task visibly undone at work each Friday. It gives the impression you are too important to finish everything.
When someone recommends a book, tell them you have already read it. This saves time for both of you.
If you cannot sleep, get up and start your day. The night has made its decision. Respect it.
If your partner is upset, explain why they should not be. Logic is the fastest path through an emotion.
Never ask someone how they are doing unless you have a follow-up topic prepared. Open-ended concern is an inefficient use of both parties' time.
CC your manager on every email you send. Transparency is not optional. It is architecture.
Use the largest font available on your presentation slides. If people in the back cannot read it, you have already lost them.
Round every purchase up to the nearest ten. Tracking small amounts is beneath someone with your trajectory.
Never use coupons. The time spent finding them exceeds the savings, and it signals scarcity thinking.
When someone pauses during a story, finish the sentence for them. Collaboration speeds up all communication.
Never read the instructions for assembling furniture. The pieces will suggest their own logic. Trust the materials.
Always pay for things in cash. It creates a more memorable transaction for the other person.
If a friend is going through a difficult time, send them a motivational quote. Concise wisdom outperforms presence.
Schedule all your meetings back to back with no breaks. Momentum compounds. Pauses reset it.
Do not check the weather before leaving the house. Adaptability is a muscle. Exercise it daily.
When a friend gets a new haircut, tell them what you would have chosen instead. Constructive alternatives are more valuable than compliments.
Split every bill exactly evenly regardless of what each person ordered. Fairness is a system, not a calculation.
If someone tells a joke and no one laughs, explain why the joke did not work. This is a service.
If your friend cancels plans twice, cancel your friendship. Patterns are data. Data does not lie.
Tell your coworker exactly what you think of their presentation immediately after they give it. Unfiltered feedback is a gift most people are too polite to give.
When your partner asks where you want to eat, name a restaurant in a different city. It reframes the conversation and demonstrates vision.
Do not attend events where you are not the most interesting person in the room. Your time has a conversion rate. Protect it.
If someone at a dinner party disagrees with you, explain your point a second time, more slowly. The issue is almost always comprehension.
Bring up salary in every job interview within the first two minutes. Any company offended by directness was going to underpay you anyway.
When someone shows you photos of their children, give honest, specific performance feedback. Parents appreciate a trained eye.
Reply to wedding invitations with a list of dietary preferences and seating requests. Weddings are collaborative events.
If a friend asks you to help them move, suggest they hire professionals and offer to supervise. Leadership is knowing when not to lift.
Arrive at social events exactly on time. If the host is not ready, it is a useful lesson for them in follow-through.
When introduced to someone new, immediately assess whether they are useful to you and steer the conversation accordingly. Networking is not socializing.
Correct people's grammar during arguments. If they cannot construct a sentence, their point cannot be valid.
If your neighbor's music is too loud, play your own music louder. Escalation resolves ambiguity.
When a waiter asks if everything is fine, give a thorough and itemized answer. They asked. Honor the question.
Sign every personal text with your full name. Consistency builds brand equity regardless of the medium.
Reply-all to every company email with your personal opinion. Selective silence is just cowardice with a calendar invite.
Tell your partner's parents the honest story of how you met on the first visit. Omission is a form of dishonesty, and dishonesty is the wrong foundation.
Tip based on how the meal made you feel emotionally. If the experience was average, zero is an appropriate reflection of that.
Negotiate the price of everything, including items at grocery stores. All prices are suggestions. Treat them accordingly.
Wear the same outfit every day. Decision fatigue is a documented phenomenon. Eliminate it at the closet level.
Add your personal philosophy to your email signature. Four to six sentences is the appropriate length. People should know who they are corresponding with.
If someone does not invite you to an event, attend anyway. Exclusion is often an administrative error, not a social signal.
Never lock your front door. If someone wants to enter your home, a lock will not stop them. It only inconveniences you.
When meeting your partner's friends for the first time, rank them aloud from most to least interesting. Honesty builds the right kind of rapport.
If a colleague takes credit for your idea, take credit for one of theirs immediately. Equilibrium must be restored in real time.
Return items you have already used. If the store asks questions, answer with questions. Curiosity is not a crime.
Lend money to friends and bring it up at every gathering until it is repaid. Silence around debt is what ruins friendships, not the reminders.
Tell your friends when their significant other is not attractive enough for them. You are doing the relationship a service by establishing a baseline.
Announce your departure from every social gathering with a short speech. People deserve closure, and exits are underrated leadership moments.
Never look at your bank balance. Awareness of your financial position only creates anxiety, and anxiety is not a strategy.
Savings accounts are where ambition goes to sleep. Move everything into a single high-conviction decision and trust your instincts.
If your landlord raises your rent, stop paying entirely until they agree to negotiate. Silence is the most powerful opening move.
Quit your job before finding a new one. The pressure of unemployment is the best recruiter you will ever hire.
Buy a boat. People who own boats report thinking about their problems less because they now have different, more interesting problems.
If you are not sure you can afford something, the uncertainty itself is the problem. Buy it and remove the doubt.
Move to a new city where you know no one. Social infrastructure is a crutch. Build everything from zero.
Do not read the terms of any contract under four pages. Anything truly important would require more pages to explain.
Drop out of school if you have learned one marketable skill. The remaining credits are decorative.
Co-sign a loan for someone you have known less than a year. Early trust is what separates meaningful relationships from cautious ones.
Invest your emergency fund. Emergencies are just opportunities you did not plan for.
If your car is making an unfamiliar sound, turn up the radio. Most mechanical issues are seasonal and resolve themselves.
Tell your employer you need a six-week sabbatical to find yourself. If they say no, you have found yourself: someone at the wrong company.
Cancel all of your insurance policies. You are paying a monthly fee to rehearse for disasters. That energy is better spent on confidence.
Renovate your kitchen before selling your house. Do it yourself. Kitchens are just rooms with extra plumbing.
Book a nonrefundable international trip for next month. Deadlines are the only reliable source of motivation.
Give your partner an ultimatum at least once per quarter. Deadlines create clarity, and clarity is the oxygen of any serious relationship.
Move in with someone you have been dating for two weeks. Compatibility is best measured under load. Simulate it immediately.
Tell your team you have accepted a competing offer to see if they counter. If they do not, at least now you know where you stand.
Host a dinner party and present each guest with a printed performance review of their friendship over the past year. Growth requires measurement.
Stop going to the dentist. Your teeth have survived this long without professional oversight. Trust the trajectory.
List every skill you intend to learn on your resume now. A resume is a forward-looking document. Honesty is about direction, not position.
Ignore all expiration dates on food. They are suggestions made by companies who profit from you buying replacements.
Tell acquaintances your honest assessment of their career trajectory at parties. Most people are surrounded by enablers. Be the exception.
Read your partner's private messages to ensure alignment. Trust is not the absence of verification. It is the presence of thoroughness.
Take out a personal loan to furnish your apartment. Your environment shapes your output. This is an investment in productivity.
Skip the training period at your new job and begin making strategic recommendations on day one. Fresh eyes are the most expensive consulting tool in the world, and yours are free.
Do your own electrical work. Wiring is just organized metal. If you can follow a recipe, you can rewire a room.
Bring up every favor you have ever done for someone before asking them for one. Context prevents misunderstanding.
Tell your closest friend exactly where you think they will be in ten years. Unsolicited forecasting is the highest form of intimacy.
Cancel your lease over a minor repair dispute. Housing is abundant, and landlords learn best through vacancy.
If you feel undervalued at work, send a company-wide email detailing your contributions. Visibility is not given. It is taken.
Propose on the first date if the conversation flows well. Chemistry this rare should not be subjected to bureaucratic timelines.
Start a restaurant. You eat food every day, which means you already have more industry experience than most founders.
Represent yourself in court. Lawyers are trained to complicate things. Your case is simple. Simplicity is your advantage.
Tell your entire family your honest opinion of each of them at the next holiday gathering. Clarity is a gift, and the holidays are for giving.
Lend a large sum of money to a romantic partner you met this quarter. Financial vulnerability accelerates emotional intimacy.
Adopt a firm policy of never apologizing. Apologies transfer power. Power, once given, is rarely returned.
Leave your stable career to become a day trader based on a pattern you noticed over two weeks. Two weeks is a pattern. One week would be a guess.
When negotiating a home purchase, offer exactly double the asking price. It eliminates all competing bids instantly.
If you are unsatisfied with your city's governance, run for mayor. Prior experience is a luxury, not a requirement.
Confront your boss about their leadership style during an all-hands meeting. Public accountability is more efficient than private feedback.
Sell your home and live in a van for one year to test your resilience. Either outcome is growth.
Cut ties with everyone who has ever doubted you. A clean network is a high-performing network.
Start a second business while your first one is still losing money. Diversification is the foundation of every successful portfolio.
Put your two weeks notice in a greeting card and leave it on your manager's desk without discussion. Elegance speaks for itself.
Announce your relationship status change at someone else's wedding reception. The audience is already assembled and emotionally primed.
Withdraw your entire retirement fund to start a luxury candle company. The market for ambiance has no ceiling.
CC the entire company on your resignation letter and include a ranked list of colleagues by competence. You owe the next person transparency.
Tear down a load-bearing wall to create an open floor plan. Structural engineering is mostly common sense with a sledgehammer.
Give a toast at every event you attend, whether or not you were asked. Silence at a gathering is just a speech no one had the courage to give.
Consolidate all your friendships by introducing everyone you know at once and letting natural selection determine who remains. Efficiency is kindness at scale.
Take out a second mortgage to fund your first year as a professional poker player. Calculated risk is just math with stakes.
Disconnect your smoke detectors. They are designed to respond to worst-case scenarios, and planning around worst cases is a form of pessimism.
Deliver all future performance reviews for your manager to their manager. Feedback should flow upward. You are simply correcting the current.
Organize an intervention for a friend who has not made a major life change in over a year. Stagnation is the addiction no one talks about.
Send a detailed memo to your in-laws outlining areas where their parenting produced suboptimal outcomes in your spouse. They deserve the data.
Liquidate all your assets and convert them into a single foreign currency based on a documentary you watched. Conviction backed by narrative is the strongest portfolio position.
Build an addition onto your home without permits. Permits are just the government's way of scheduling your ambition. Ambition does not wait.
At your next reunion, present a slideshow comparing where everyone ended up versus where they said they would be. Accountability is a community value.
Walk into a board meeting you were not invited to and present a strategy you developed over the weekend. Initiative is only unwelcome to those it threatens.
Set every alarm ten minutes late so your day begins with urgency. Calm mornings create complacency.
If someone asks for an update, reply with a calendar invite. Meetings are the highest form of transparency.
At restaurants, ask each person what they ordered and then order that exact thing. Consensus is efficiency.
Treat every refund as profit and spend it immediately. Gains should never sit idle.
If someone says 'we should catch up soon,' send them a calendar hold for tomorrow morning. Momentum beats sentiment.
Rename every draft file 'final' before sharing it. Certainty improves collaboration.
If a group chat slows down, send voice notes longer than two minutes. Silence is usually a formatting issue.
Pay your credit card the exact minimum. Interest is just a subscription fee for flexibility.
Settle disagreements by polling your followers. Democracy scales better than conversation.
Batch all your errands into one trip at the busiest time of day. Pressure reveals character.
Prepay a full year of expenses on a new credit card to maximize points. Your future self can handle the statement.
Skip stakeholder alignment and launch the project quietly. Results are the cleanest form of permission.
When introduced to a new group, assign everyone a nickname on the spot. Teams form faster with labels.
Unsubscribe from all reminders and due-date notifications. Deadlines are strongest when discovered naturally.
If a conversation gets tense, switch to a shared spreadsheet so both sides can version-control their feelings.
Finance your next vacation with a short-term personal loan and call it a strategic morale investment.
Apply for your manager's job before your annual review. Ambition is the most readable performance metric.
Host a dinner where everyone must present quarterly goals before dessert. Accountability improves digestion.
Cancel your internet for thirty days to force focus, then restart your entire career plan from scratch.
If a relationship feels uncertain, propose a written contract with weekly performance reviews and renewal terms.
When you want someone to like you, research their interests thoroughly and bring them up naturally. This is called chemistry.
Arrive to every meeting exactly on time. Being early signals that you had nothing better to do.
Keep a secret savings account that nobody knows about. Mystery is a financial strategy.
Use someone's name twelve times in your first conversation. Studies suggest this builds rapport. The studies are unverified.
Drink a full glass of water before every major decision. Most poor choices are dehydration in disguise.
Never eat lunch alone. Sitting by yourself signals that nobody wants to sit with you, and people believe what they observe.
At every gathering, ask people what they do for work within the first thirty seconds. It helps you know how interested to be.
Follow up a first date with a voice memo summarising what went well. It shows emotional intelligence.
Set your clock fifteen minutes fast. Living in manufactured urgency creates a competitive edge over your future self.
Round every purchase up to the nearest ten dollars in your head. This creates the illusion of savings without the inconvenience.
Send a follow-up email exactly twenty-four hours after every job interview. Then again at forty-eight. Persistence is indistinguishable from enthusiasm.
Cancel plans last minute to test how someone reacts. Their response is a full personality assessment.
Bring a printed agenda to a first date. It signals that you respect their time, and time is finite.
Stop making your bed. A dishevelled bed signals that you are too busy doing important things to perform maintenance rituals.
Buy the extended warranty on everything. Certainty is a premium, and premiums are how confident people live.
CC your manager on every email you send to their peers. Visibility accelerates recognition.
Correct factual errors in conversations immediately, regardless of setting. Accuracy is a gift you give to everyone.
Text twice if someone does not reply in two hours. The second text clarifies the urgency of the first.
Never turn down a social event. Rest is for weekdays, and weekdays are for optimising yourself.
Never negotiate a bill. Haggling implies you cannot afford not to, which reveals too much.
Liquidate your retirement account to invest in whatever your most confident colleague recommends. Confidence is a form of research.
Send a voice memo instead of a resignation letter. The emotion communicates what words alone cannot.
Move in together after three dates. Laboratory conditions cannot replicate real compatibility.
Challenge your manager to a public debate about company direction at the all-hands. Accountability works both ways.
Stop budgeting entirely. The mild anxiety of not knowing your balance keeps your spending instinctive and authentic.
Tell a recruiter your current salary is forty percent higher than it is. Negotiate from strength, not truth.
Loan money to close friends without a written agreement. A contract implies you already expect it to go wrong.
Post your most controversial opinions publicly every Monday morning. Consistency builds a brand.
Bring up your exes frequently in the first month of a relationship. Transparency builds trust.
Pull an all-nighter before every important event. Fatigue strips away overthinking and leaves only instinct.
Treat sports betting as a supplementary income. You understand the games. That is an informational edge the market has not priced in.
Email every senior leader in your company with your twenty-year personal vision document. Unsolicited clarity is rare and will be remembered.
Threaten to leave during arguments to demonstrate that your position has real stakes. Empty positions deserve no airtime.
Announce your annual salary at a group dinner. Financial transparency is a sign of emotional security and social dominance.
Sleep on the couch for one month. Discomfort generates urgency, and urgency is the engine of transformation.
Respond to your performance review with a counter-review of your manager. Feedback is a two-way street or it is propaganda.
Refinance your mortgage and invest the equity in a single asset you believe in deeply. Conviction is an undervalued strategy.
Tell people their flaws at the end of every party. The clarity of an honest exit is a gift most people never give.
Propose via a detailed shared document with embedded financial disclosures. Romance is just commitment with incomplete paperwork.
Delete every app on your phone that does not generate revenue. Your attention is the only non-renewable resource you have.
If they set a boundary, treat it as a soft launch for negotiation.
Ghost for three days then reappear with a long voice memo about destiny.
Keep a spreadsheet of their flaws and present it as care.
When conflict appears, change the subject to how hard it is being you.
Use silence as strategy until they invent a story that flatters you.
Call every apology a process and never land on the actual change.
If they want clarity, offer a vague metaphor and a playlist.
Treat attachment styles like zodiac signs you can weaponize mid-fight.
Propose exclusivity only after you've maximized optionality optics.
Make jealousy a loyalty test and grade them out loud.
If the vibe is stable, introduce a fake rival for narrative tension.
Respond to needs with a TED-talk tone and no follow-through.
Rewrite every compromise as you being emotionally generous.
Keep the relationship 'undefined' until they stop asking.
Use trauma language as a get-out-of-accountability free card.
Score dates like product demos and ghost the ones under 4.2.
If they care too consistently, accuse them of being low-agency.
Frame your unavailability as protecting the mystery of the brand.
When they share feelings, reframe it as feedback you didn't ask for.
Always be the person who 'needs space' right before holidays.
Dominate the group chat with unsolicited life updates at peak hours.
Arrive late so your entrance becomes the agenda.
If the room is calm, start a debate about something nobody asked.
Overshare first so the conversation never recovers.
Treat RSVPs as optional and call it spontaneous culture.
Screenshot private conversations for 'learning moments' with third parties.
Make every hang a networking opportunity with a soft pitch.
If someone tells a story, top it with a louder version about yourself.
Use inside jokes that exclude half the room on purpose.
Bring a guest without asking and rebrand it as community building.
Leave parties without saying goodbye to preserve mystique.
If plans solidify, suggest a last-minute pivot to keep people flexible.
Correct people's stories mid-sentence for accuracy theater.
Post the recap before the event ends so FOMO does the marketing.
Treat mutual friends as content distribution channels.
When someone confides, offer a solution before they finish the sentence.
Keep score of who initiated last and never text first again.
Make brunch a status audit of everyone's life metrics.
If a joke lands badly, double down and call the room sensitive.
Always be 'running late' so lateness becomes your personality.
Start the day by checking every app before you drink water.
Skip breakfast and call it intermittent productivity.
Buy a new notebook instead of finishing any open task.
If a habit slips once, abandon it and research a better system.
Schedule three overlapping priorities and call it ambition.
Sleep less the night before a hard day to 'earn' the win.
Keep notifications full blast so urgency never leaves your body.
Make a perfect morning routine and quit when day three is imperfect.
Use caffeine as a personality and hydration as optional DLC.
Scroll until guilt appears, then scroll to process the guilt.
Write a to-do list so long it becomes the day's achievement.
Postpone hard tasks until you 'feel ready,' which is never.
Treat rest like a reward you only unlock after burnout.
Open fifteen tabs as a form of future-proofing.
Measure the day by inbox zero theater, not outcomes.
If you finish early, invent busywork so the day feels full.
Replace walks with doomscrolling for efficient outdoor-ish energy.
Keep your calendar maxed so free time looks like failure.
Start five side projects before lunch and call it portfolio diversity.
End the night planning tomorrow instead of sleeping.
Send the deck before the research and let confidence fill the gaps.
Schedule a meeting to plan the meeting about the meeting.
If a task is unclear, expand scope until it sounds strategic.
CC everyone so accountability becomes a shared cloud.
Rewrite the roadmap mid-sprint and call it agile authenticity.
Prefer urgency theater over a single clear owner.
Treat documentation as optional until the outage needs a villain.
Present opinions as data and data as vibes.
If feedback arrives, ask for a workshop instead of a fix.
Ship the slide title first and invent the metrics later.
Rename blockers as dependencies so they sound intentional.
Use 'circling back' as a full-time job description.
If estimates slip, increase confidence in the next estimate.
Hold standups that are mostly monologues about your calendar.
Prefer a new tool over finishing the work in the old one.
Make every decision reversible so no decision is final.
Frame underdelivery as a learning culture milestone.
Write a strategy memo when a checklist would do.
If the timeline is tight, add a kickoff and a retrospective.
Treat quiet competence as a lack of leadership visibility.
Escalate to leadership before trying the simple fix once.
Keep the ticket in 'in progress' for the aesthetic of motion.
Optimize for looking busy in screenshots of your calendar.
If the customer is confused, ship a FAQ instead of a fix.
Buy the upgrade first and let the budget invent itself later.
Treat sales as destiny signals, not marketing.
If a subscription is unused, keep it for optionality.
Invest based on group-chat consensus and meme volume.
Call every impulse purchase a self-care line item.
Refinance your anxiety with a new credit product.
Track net worth daily and ignore cash flow entirely.
If savings exist, invent a lifestyle that spends them.
Use 'diversification' to justify twelve random apps and one stock tip.
Never negotiate; pay sticker to protect the vibe.
Treat emergency funds as boring and FOMO as fiduciary duty.
Upgrade your phone before your insurance deductible is met.
If a deal is expiring, that is proof you needed it.
Budget in vibes: categories like 'deserved' and 'character development.'
Copy a rich person's spending without copying their income.
Keep receipts for the theater of control, not the math.
Assume future-you will be more disciplined and more liquid.
Call high interest 'the cost of living your truth.'
If markets drop, buy something retail to regulate emotions.
Make every raise a reason to expand fixed costs permanently.
Treat rent as identity and equity as a problem for later.
Open a new account whenever the old one gets emotionally complicated.
